description: Full-window evaluation dataset for Belltower: two years (1 January 2025 to 31 December 2026) of what six invented sources published about the fictional city of Halden, with updates, corrections, retractions, copies and reports, and one account's follow rules, preferences, read marks, clippings, notifications and activity log. Synthetic; separate from the smoke fixture (fixtures/minimal.json).

sources.description: Generated by dev/dataset.cjs: story templates for two official sources, two newsrooms and two aggregators of an invented city (road works, notices, hearings, libraries, transit, health, schools, safety, business and community news, with seasonal and scripted events), seeded random timing and follow-ups, and the account holder's own actions, all applied through the App's own events and tools. No real person, place, publisher or website; nothing collected.

generation.method: seeded story templates replayed through the App business functions (mulberry32 generator)

transformations: None: seed.json is the App state exactly as the replay leaves it, written as compact JSON (sha256 028b16b72493f1dd40bf34b38a287dea2fa702dcca4dca87961aae1e303c1758).

review.notes: Automated checks (seed schema and rules every 300 steps and at the end, dev/coverage.cjs, tests/dataset.integration.cjs) do not replace human review of realism: the templated wording, the publishing rate, the share of corrections and retractions, and that every source, place and person is fictional.
